content: Noritate is a topical cream that is commonly prescribed for the treatment of rosacea, a chronic skin condition often associated with adult acne. This condition is characterized by frequent or persistent facial flushing, particularly in the areas around the cheeks and chin. The active ingredient in Noritate is metronidazole at a concentration of 1%. Metronidazole is an anti-inflammatory agent that is intended to reduce redness and inflammation in affected areas of the skin. While Noritate may help to eliminate some pustules and decrease redness in certain individuals, it has been documented to cause acne in a very small percentage of users. According to the drug's informational pamphlet, adverse effects are reported in only 1% of users. However, it is important to note that many individuals using Noritate do not experience a significant reduction in the general redness associated with rosacea. In some cases, the redness may even worsen. Similar outcomes have been observed with Metrogel, another topical treatment that also contains 1% metronidazole as its active ingredient.
